blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The first passenger train in India ran on April 16, 1853, between Bombay (Bori Bunder) and Thane.
Indian Railways was nationalized in 1951 and is currently divided into 19 administrative zones.
Bholu, an elephant holding a signal lamp, serves as the official mascot of Indian Railways.
Indian Railways uses three main gauge types: Broad Gauge (1676 mm), Meter Gauge (1000 mm), and Narrow Gauge (762 mm / 610 mm).
